boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Buffalo corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Elmwood Avenue: Buffalo AKG Art Museum
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Elmwood Avenue and use the museum’s digital guide to orient yourself before choosing galleries or a scheduled group experience.
cards.short_summary: A museum stop directly on Elmwood Avenue beside Delaware Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Buffalo AKG Art Museum is located at 1285 Elmwood Avenue and offers a free digital guide on Bloomberg Connects.
cards.source_title: Buffalo AKG Art Museum Frequently Asked Questions
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current admission and gallery information before visiting.

cards.title: Elmwood Avenue: Burchfield Penney Art Center
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan a gallery visit around the Charles Burchfield collection, then leave time to see the recreated artist’s studio and archival material.
cards.short_summary: A Buffalo art center with Burchfield works and a recreated studio.
cards.evidence_claim: Burchfield Penney Art Center at 1300 Elmwood Avenue holds the largest public collection of Charles E. Burchfield works and includes a recreation of his studio.
cards.access_notes: Verify current gallery hours and admission details with the art center.

cards.title: Elmwood Avenue: The Buffalo History Museum
cards.subtitle: Elmwood Avenue and Nottingham Terrace corridor
cards.notes: Use the Elmwood bus stop at Nottingham as your approach, then allow time for a self-paced tour of regional history galleries.
cards.short_summary: A self-paced regional-history museum reached from Elmwood Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buffalo History Museum is at 1 Museum Court and is served by the Elmwood Bus #20 at Elmwood and Nottingham; its museum visit is self-touring and self-paced.
cards.source_title: Visit Us at The Buffalo History Museum
cards.access_notes: Confirm current admission and opening information before traveling.

cards.title: Parkside Avenue: Buffalo Zoo
cards.subtitle: Parkside Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Parkside Avenue address for arrival and select a daytime visit or an all-ages listed program that fits the current calendar.
cards.short_summary: A zoo destination on Parkside Avenue with public programming.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buffalo Zoo is located at 300 Parkside Avenue, Buffalo, and its official calendar lists public events at that venue.
cards.access_notes: General admission is ticketed; review current zoo admission and event requirements.

cards.title: Meadow Drive: Japanese Garden in Delaware Park
cards.subtitle: Meadow Drive corridor, Delaware Park
cards.notes: Walk the garden’s paths at your own pace and use the self-guided audio-tour stops to notice water, islands, and changing views.
cards.short_summary: A six-acre strolling garden on public parkland.
cards.evidence_claim: The Japanese Garden in Delaware Park spans more than six acres, uses a strolling-garden design, and is freely accessible on public parkland.
cards.source_title: Buffalo Olmsted Parks Conservancy specialty gardens
cards.access_notes: Use public paths and follow posted park guidance; the garden is freely accessible.

cards.title: Meadow Drive: Delaware Park Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Meadow Drive corridor, Delaware Park
cards.notes: Make a slow loop through the formal beds when roses are in season, and keep the pergola and fountain as orientation points.
cards.short_summary: A formal public rose garden within Delaware Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Delaware Park Rose Garden was conceived in 1917 and has a French-symmetrical design, central fountain, and pergola.
cards.source_title: Buffalo Olmsted Parks Conservancy specialty gardens
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor park feature; check conditions and any event reservations before visiting.

cards.title: Jewett Parkway: Frank Lloyd Wright's Martin House
cards.subtitle: Jewett Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Arrive early for a booked interior tour, or start at the pavilion’s interpretive displays to understand the estate and its restoration.
cards.short_summary: A restored Frank Lloyd Wright estate with interpretive displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Frank Lloyd Wright’s Martin House is at 125 Jewett Parkway; the pavilion has interpretive displays, while interior visits require a purchased tour.
cards.source_title: Prepare for Your Visit: Martin House
cards.access_notes: Interior historic-home access requires a purchased tour; review current tour availability.

cards.title: Main Street: Forest Lawn Cemetery
cards.subtitle: Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter through the Main Street gate for a daytime walk and use the current gate schedule to plan a respectful visit within open hours.
cards.short_summary: A historic cemetery and accredited Level II arboretum on Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Forest Lawn Cemetery is a 269-acre Level II Arboretum accredited by ArbNet, with its Wendt Center at 1990 Main Street.
cards.access_notes: Forest Lawn is open daily; gates close at 7 p.m. March 23–September 30 and 5 p.m. October 1–March 22.

cards.title: Hertel Avenue: North Park Theatre
cards.subtitle: Hertel Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the current showtime calendar, then see a film on the theater’s single historic screen and 4K laser projection system.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit historic cinema on Hertel Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: North Park Theatre is a nonprofit cinema at 1428 Hertel Avenue and presents films using a 4K laser projector.
cards.access_notes: Review current showtimes and ticket availability before arriving.

cards.title: Hertel Avenue: North Park Branch Library
cards.subtitle: Hertel Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Bring a study task or a small group and use the branch’s public computers, Wi-Fi, or community meeting-room information as needed.
cards.short_summary: A public-library branch with computers, Wi-Fi, and community space.
cards.evidence_claim: North Park Branch Library is at 975 Hertel Avenue and provides free Wi-Fi plus 22 public computers with Microsoft Office free for public use.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current branch hours; public-computer and Wi-Fi use are listed as free.
